goal: Bind applicable goal acceptance to Canonical Final Verdict as an independently inspected veto-only support prerequisite.
acceptance_criteria: A passing goal-acceptance support receipt cannot replace any formal gate or promote a non-PASS formal-gate aggregate.
A production run with a frozen GoalDrivenProjectPlan requires a readable, self-consistent PASS CGKNGoalAcceptance receipt before Canonical Final Verdict can PASS.
Canonical Final Verdict independently rereads the goal specification, project plan, mapped candidate test sources, and receipt hashes instead of trusting the receipt status.
Legacy production runs without goal-plan artifacts preserve the existing final-verdict behavior, and Provider generation plus local_packager delivery routes remain unchanged.
Missing, non-PASS, mismatched, or tampered applicable goal acceptance produces NEEDS_REWORK even when every formal gate reports PASS.

quality_metrics.measure: formal provider and delivery route preservation
quality_metrics.target: kernel and provider contract tests pass without a new generation or delivery path
quality_metrics.method: existing kernel and formal provider test profiles

quality_metrics.measure: canonical goal behaviors mapped to substantive executable tests and a real passing post-build test run
quality_metrics.target: every canonical test intent has one exact non-trivial test symbol and the post-build goal-acceptance receipt is PASS before review readiness
quality_metrics.method: deterministic plan-identity inspection, Python test AST inspection, post-build test-result binding, and negative missing/trivial/failed-test cases

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

interface_expectations: acceptance_verifier keeps every existing formal required gate necessary for PASS and records goal acceptance separately as support
goal_acceptance independently rereads the frozen goal, plan, and candidate test sources but never calls the final-verdict producer
formal_mainline_acceptance passes only the existing production candidate and production run roots into the final-verdict inspection context
legacy runs without goal-plan artifacts remain not applicable and preserve prior final-verdict aggregation
evidence_refs: management/schema validation and git diff check (PASS)
pytest goal acceptance, final verdict, provider, Codex conversation, delivery, scale, and kernel regression (PASS: 286 passed, 195 skipped)

feedback: Applicable goal acceptance is now independently rechecked by Canonical Final Verdict as a veto-only support prerequisite bound to canonical test execution; legacy runs remain compatible.

worked: Keeping goal acceptance outside required_gates preserved formal authority while allowing independent veto semantics.
did_not_work: The first official quick invocation supplied a result-file path where the runner expected an output directory; it exited before collecting tests and was rerun correctly.
experiments: Keep support prerequisites structurally separate from formal gates and require cross-binding to the canonical evidence they summarize.
